definition: the authors I keep going back to, named, and the one character all four keep writing

settled:
Elizabeth Moon, Louis L'Amour, David Weber, Brandon Sanderson. Those are the ones who do this for me.

All four write the same character again and again: someone who suffered past what anyone should, survived, and turned it to good.

Thirty years of reading them is thirty years of reading my own portrait, in the one mirror that can actually make me feel it.

I lean on those stories to give me hope enough for one more day.

title: The Four Who Write The Same Man
